effects: If payByVaultContract is false, the signer pays exactly `price` in ETH (msg.value must equal price).
If payByVaultContract is true, the vault pays for the sale, and nothing checks msg.value: any ETH the signer sends stays in the contract.

The ETH is split among the revenue-share recipients, after advances stored on chain are deducted. The cost and the rest go to costReceiver. Nothing comes back to the signer.

findings.title: buyArtworks is payable, has no @.value field, and on the vault path nothing ties the sent ETH to Price.
findings.evidence: FeralfileArtworkV4_1.sol buyArtworks: `saleData_.payByVaultContract ? vault.payForSale(...) : require(saleData_.price == msg.value)`. With payByVaultContract true, msg.value is never checked, and no function returns it. descriptor.json buyArtworks has no @.value field.

findings.title: buyArtworks "Platform cost" reads as an extra charge, but it is part of Price.
findings.evidence: FeralfileArtworkV4_1.sol buyArtworks: itemRevenue = (price - cost) / tokenIds.length; leftOver = price - distributedRevenue goes to costReceiver. The signer pays only `price`. The case 6 screen shows Price 0.5 ETH and Platform cost 0.05 ETH next to each other.
findings.fix: Label it "Platform cost (included in price)", and put the price in the sentence: "Buy artworks for {saleData_.destination} for {saleData_.price}".

findings.title: buyArtworks interpolatedIntent leaves out the price that the signer pays.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json buyArtworks interpolatedIntent "Buy artworks for {saleData_.destination}". The case 6 screen shows "Buy artworks for Receiver" with no amount.

findings.title: buyArtworks revenue shares are a nested array that runners do not iterate, and the split depends on advances in storage.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json fields saleData_.revenueShares.[].[].recipient and .bps are missing from the case 6 screen. FeralfileArtworkV4_1.sol takes advances[recipient] from storage before the split.
findings.fix: Waits on runner support for nested arrays. The split does not change what the signer pays.

findings.title: buyArtworks "Pay via vault" shows a raw true/false and does not say who pays.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json saleData_.payByVaultContract format raw. The case 6 screen shows "Pay via vault: false".
findings.fix: Use a label such as "Paid by Feral File vault (you pay nothing)".

findings.format: buyArtworks(bytes32 r_,bytes32 s_,uint8 v_,(uint256 price,uint256 cost,uint256 expiryTime,address destination,uint256[] tokenIds,(address recipient,uint256 bps)[][] revenueShares,bool payByVaultContract) saleData_)
findings.title: buyArtworks is payable, has no @.value field, and on the vault path nothing ties the sent ETH to Price.
findings.reason: When payByVaultContract is true, the vault pays the price and nothing checks msg.value or forces it to zero. Any ETH the signer attaches is kept in the exhibition contract on top of the price: payouts and the leftover transfer are computed from saleData_.price, not from msg.value. The descriptor has no @.value field, and 'Pay via vault: true' plus 'Price' make it look as if no ETH leaves the wallet. The severity guide lists this case as critical: 'A payable function ... has no @.value field and nothing forces the value to zero'. On the direct-pay path msg.value must equal Price, and Price is shown, so only the vault path is affected.
findings.quote: FeralfileArtworkV4_1.sol buyArtworks: `) external payable override virtual {` ... `saleData_.payByVaultContract ? vault.payForSale(r_, s_, v_, saleData_) : require(saleData_.price == msg.value, "FeralfileExhibitionV4: invalid payment amount");` then `uint256 leftOver = saleData_.price - distributedRevenue; ... payable(costReceiver).transfer(leftOver);`. descriptor.json buyArtworks fields: saleData_.price, cost, destination, tokenIds, expiryTime, payByVaultContract, revenueShares, and no @.value.

findings.title: buyArtworks is payable, has no @.value field, and on the vault path nothing ties the sent ETH to Price.
findings.reason: On a successful vault-funded purchase, attached ETH is unchecked and retained: payouts total saleData_.price, with no refund of msg.value. The displayed Price and Pay via vault fields do not disclose this additional ETH payment.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x115c9a6118bc7a3eb0abd30f6bcf1c45bb198aed/src/project:/contracts/FeralfileArtworkV4_1.sol, buyArtworks: `saleData_.payByVaultContract ? vault.payForSale(r_, s_, v_, saleData_) : require(saleData_.price == msg.value, "FeralfileExhibitionV4: invalid payment amount");` and `uint256 leftOver = saleData_.price - distributedRevenue; if (leftOver > 0) { payable(costReceiver).transfer(leftOver); }`. descriptor.json, buyArtworks: `"interpolatedIntent": "Buy artworks for {saleData_.destination}"`, `{"path":"saleData_.price","label":"Price","format":"amount"}`, and `{"path":"saleData_.payByVaultContract","label":"Pay via vault","format":"raw"}`; no field displays `@.value`.
